gen-amatic-sc-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear reads tall and open, its plain sans letters wide-mouthed and easy on the eye. Beside it, Amatic SC's skeletal handwriting looks hand-scribbled and quirky, and that gap between spindly and sturdy is the pair's best trick.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-pridi: Scrawled yet dignified. Pridi follows Amatic SC with small letters that stand almost capital-sized, and that lofty, refined body is what makes the rustic heading feel grounded.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-pt-sans-caption: Amatic SC writes like a bent straw, rustic and quirky, with each stroke thin and loose. PT Sans Caption does the opposite job, its big-bodied lowercase and inviting bowls holding the text steady while the heading plays.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-puritan: Puritan has rounded forms that stay open to the side, with oversized e and a counters that read friendly. Puritan against Amatic SC's hand-lettered strokes gives the pair its strongest quality: scribbled personality sitting over a sans that simply gets on with it.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-questrial: Questrial stands tall and flat, almost stencil-cut, with short stalks above a generous band of lowercase. Over a long passage it would read smoothly and modern, while Amatic SC's rustic scrawl stays up top to add some mischief.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada has tall, full lowercase c, s and z, drawn in one steady line with open curve ends. Amatic SC's quirky pen-and-paper letters sit above it, and the two feel like a sketched title over tidy typing.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-radio-canada-big: Spindly and handmade up top, solid below. Amatic SC wanders in its rustic way, and Radio Canada Big, a sans with a tall x-height and monoline skeleton, steadies it with terminals that finish well clear of the stem.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro keeps broad gaps at its terminals and a smooth, unvarying weight from word to word. Amatic SC does the quirky, handwritten flourish best; Readex Pro does quiet, dependable text.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-roboto: Quirky hand-lettering over a modern workhorse. Amatic SC is best at rustic charm, with its pen-drawn nib strokes, while Roboto is best at clear, generous round letters that keep the text easy to take in.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-ruda: Wiry, scrawled charm meets sturdy text. Amatic SC handles the rustic, quirky voice best, while Ruda, a sans with a sizable x-height and wide-mouthed rounds, is built to make screen reading feel approachable.
